## Digest algorithm (P16.13 baseline)

From repository root:

```bash
find packages/<pkg>/src -name '*.php' | sort | while read -r f; do sha256sum "$f"; done | sha256sum
```

## P16.9 — `corex/panels` (batch E16d, retained)

**Profile:** A · **Decision:** D93 · **Actor:** plan-exec / composer-2.5 / medium

## Naming verdict (five ecosystems)

Official primary documentation was compared for Filament, Laravel Nova, Orchid Platform, Backpack
for Laravel, and MoonShine. Capture: `@plan/knowledge/research-P16-design-rag.json` §2,
`@plan/knowledge/artifacts-P16-design-rag-P16-Q1.json`. Provenance URLs: `docs/reference.md` (panel vocabulary rows).

| Ecosystem | Official primary term | Why rename is rejected |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Filament | Panel (aggregate shell) | CoreX panel is headless metadata, not a Filament-style shell. |
| Laravel Nova | Resource, Dashboard, Menu | Would imply Nova Resource/Dashboard semantics. |
| Orchid | Screen | Would imply Screen/page rendering, not descriptor catalogue. |
| Backpack | admin panel, CRUD panel | Would imply admin/CRUD application area. |
| MoonShine | admin panel + Resource/Page/Dashboard | Would imply product shell + child UI types. |

**Verdict:** Keep `corex/panels`, `CoreX\Panels`, and layer-first profile A.

## Use-case span

| Named use case | Top-level `src/` span |
|:--|:--|
| Register and resolve headless panel descriptors for the active module/entity context | `Contracts/`, `Data/`, `Internal/`, root provider (layer split; ≤ 2 folders per concern) |

**Production file count:** 11 PHP files in `src/`.
